Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL5291721. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return all rows including those without structures. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
